## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-juan late-Míng supplement to the *Wǔdēng huìyuán* 五燈會元 ([KR6q0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0012)), continuing the Chán lineage record from the Southern Sòng into the Yuán and Míng. Compiled by [淨柱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%9F%B1) Jìngzhù, a Cáodòng-line monk, and completed in the closing years of the Chóngzhēn reign (the standard dating is 1640 – early 1640s, ambiguous in the sources).

**Abstract**

One of several seventeenth-century lamp-record continuations addressing the perceived need to update [普濟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E6%BF%9F) Pǔjì's 1252 synthesis for the Yuán-Míng generations. Jìngzhù's compilation is more compressed than the parallel efforts by [文琇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E7%90%87) Wénxiù ([KR6q0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0017)) and [通容](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E5%AE%B9) Tōngróng ([KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019)), drawing primarily on Míng monastic biographical literature. The Cáodòng-line perspective gives the work a modest corrective emphasis against the Línjì-dominant *Wǔdēng yántǒng* 五燈嚴統 ([KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019)) compiled around the same time.
